governance.dispatch: Existing YAML orchestrator dispatches dependency-ready original work loops in parallel before planning reviews. Return dispatch-ready complete without starting substitute agents. governance.semanticEntryGates: Scheduler agreement permits dependency scheduling, not effects. Every consumer independently requires its concrete input proof. A bounded agreed unresolved inventory/trial/G1-G4 report cannot authorize publication, follow-up or stop. Missing proof yields explicit blocked/unreached findings without another parent/send.
governance.ownership: Scrum owns this JSON and application index only. RP-S3-EVIDENCE-CHECKS owns focused portable acceptance assertions/tests. Runner owns retained lab runner/helpers/tests/index only in the substantiated feature tooling checkout. Integration exclusively reconciles handed-off source and both indexes. DevOps owns private invocation evidence and execution, never unreviewed source or sealed-stage edits.
governance.git: Fresh application baseline was clean on the authorized feature branch. Lab/sibling ownership is not newly verified. Preserve unrelated staged/dirty paths; no shared branch switch, stash/reset, lock removal, amendments, force-push or branch deletion. Owners commit explicit paths with git commit --only before review and required Copilot trailer; include observed metadata only. Integration accounts every task commit on the feature branch or records retained task/branch/commits/abandonment reason in a feature-branch commit message, preserving branches. Reviewed scoped push belongs to integration.
governance.resources: Matching exclusiveResources include review duration, not OS or cross-run isolation. No two independent deployers. Retained tooling must enforce actual publisher, CLI, transport, mount and parent ownership across runs. Recovery and isolation share execution resources but have no invented dependency on each other.
governance.authority: Exactly three existing roles, sole validated project and dedicated lab profile. Use deterministic local repository scripts, explicit application/canonical-lab/tooling roots and existing absolute validated Python. Import private settings only via application Use-Settings.ps1 and existing native settings without printing values. Necessary evidenced chosen-path permission deltas are pre-approved but require exact scope/rationale and reviewed deterministic plan/write/readback. No new infrastructure, GitHub Actions, target substitution, trust replacement, credential retrieval, provider submission or speculative identity headers.
governance.holds: Preserve UNKNOWN publications, held parents, rollback assets and historical cleanup uncertainty. Never replay uncertain effects, repurpose opaque call IDs as user identity or adopt held parents. Missing supported provider remedy or interactive authentication is a precise external stop; material contract changes go through existing Architect-advised PO/Scrum reconciliation. Do not reset originating stops. Productive rounds have no total cap.
governance.privacy: Exact private evidence, bindings, locators, transcripts, fingerprints, settings, packages and state stay outside customer Git and shareable output. Account-wide Blob Contributor provides application-enforced role/parent isolation, not malicious-host storage isolation.

criticalPath.implementation: Ownership evidence 25 + retained runner 130 + integration 75 = approximately 230 task-minutes; independent evidence-check implementation/review 120 overlaps the ownership/runner lane.
criticalPath.devops: After original formal E2E, inventory 60 + exact release/trial 125 + G1-G4 65 + continuity 75 + recovery 70 + delivery 60 = approximately 455 task-minutes. Isolation 55 has only G1-G4 as technical prerequisite but shares serialized transport/acceptance resources; reserve its additional 55 minutes.
criticalPath.total: Approximately 740 task-minutes across the critical implementation and serialized DevOps lanes, plus unestimated E2E, scheduling and genuine external stops. Estimates are rough, not deadlines, concurrency limits or execution caps.
criticalPath.minimalEdges: No Developer depends on DevOps. Evidence checks need accepted interfaces/fixtures, not lab ownership, runner completion or cloud inventory. Integration joins reviewed implementations and consumes accepted application preparation without redispatch. Recovery consumes completed two-turn state; isolation consumes only G1-G4 and is independent of recovery. Final reporting joins both.
